title: Finite decision trees
statement: For an alphabet $\Omega$, a set of labels $\alpha$, a natural number $n$, and an available set $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of coordinates, a finite decision tree is either a leaf carrying a label in $\alpha$, or a query at a coordinate in $A$ with one child tree for each possible answer in $\Omega$. Each child has the available set with the queried coordinate removed.
hypotheses_covered: available coordinate set A ⊆ Fin n
